title: Royal Plaza On Scotts — claimed by eclipse
description: SG · Hospitality · Royal Plaza on Scotts Hotel is a five-star independent hotel located in the heart of Singapore's Orchard Road, offering spacious and modern accommodations. With a legacy of over 50 years, it has been recognized as Asia Pacific's Best Independent Hotel, providing guests with a comfortable stay and award-winning halal-certified dining at its renowned Carousel restaurant.
